newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: No progress on Falklands - Argentine minister.
newsitem.headline: No progress on Falklands - Argentine minister.

text.p: Argentina's Foreign Minister Guido Di Tella said on Monday both Britons and Falkland islanders made it clear they were not ready to discuss sovereignty over the disputed South Atlantic islands.

"We presented our points of view and the answer was ... that they are not prepared to discuss anything today," he told reporters after returning from Britain where he had discussions with British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind.

"The islanders left no doubt that they do not agree with the transfer of sovereignty or with discussing any solution regarding sovereignty," he added. Two Falkland islands representatives attended the meeting.
In London, British officials said Rifkind and Di Tella agreed in weekend talks to resume negotiations on fishing rights in disputed waters near the Falklands.
But they also reaffirmed London's position that there could be no question of its offering to share or transfer sovereignty of the islands Argentina calls the Malvinas.
"This came as no surprise," said Di Tella, who sent the islanders Christmas cards, books and videos as part of a "charm policy". He said there were no plans for future meetings.
